function.description: Find local movie theatres and their schedule for a specific movie Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

The user wants to find two movie theaters near San Diego that have showtimes: 5pm for "Tenet" (天能) and 7:30pm for "007生死交戰" (No Time To Die). We need to use the function find_movie_showing. The function signature: find_movie_showing takes location: string, movie: "Tenet" | "No Time To Die"[], time: string[]. So we need to call it twice? Actually we need two theaters. But the function returns schedule for a specific movie. We can call it with location "San Diego, CA", movie "Tenet", time ["17:00"] and then again with movie "No Time To Die", time ["19:30"]. But the user wants two theaters that have both showtimes? Or two separate theaters: one for Tenet at 5pm, another for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. The phrasing: "尋找兩家電影院，位於聖地牙哥附近，提供下午5點的《天能》和晚上7點半的《007生死交戰》場次。" Means "Find two movie theaters near San Diego that offer a 5pm showing of Tenet and a 7:30pm showing of No Time To Die." Could be interpreted as find two theaters that each have those showtimes? Or find two theaters: one for Tenet at 5pm, one for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. Likely the latter: find two theaters, one for Tenet at 5pm, one for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. So we need to call function twice.

We need to provide location: "San Diego, CA". For Tenet: time ["17:00"]. For No Time To Die: time ["19:30"].

We should call the function twice. Use the function.
